Hi —

Telemetry / cookies notes you can pass to Acme:

1) Console telemetry (default):
- We collect anonymized usage metrics (API call counts, latency distributions, feature toggles usage) to support performance monitoring and billing accuracy.
- We never store raw customer prompts in persistent telemetry; request content is only stored if the customer enables logging or uploads data for evaluation.
- Per-customer telemetry toggles: Dedicated and Private customers can opt out of telemetry and metrics collection via account settings or a config flag; for Hosted plans, customers can request telemetry suppression on a per-tenant basis with the right contract addendum.

2) Docs site / marketing cookies:
- The public docs site uses standard analytics cookies (Google Analytics) and tracking for page views and search. These are separate from product telemetry and do not contain customer identifiers.
- Customers can opt out of marketing cookies via the cookie banner, and we provide a cookieless docs feed (docs.redwood.ai/static) on request for security-sensitive customers.

3) Data retention and export:
- Telemetry aggregates are retained for 13 months by default; logs that include operational traces are rotated and archived per our retention policy (outlined in the SOC2 summary).

I'll draft a short paragraph for the questionnaire on these points and include doc links.

Dev
